lessons: Before a decisive step is accepted, name which of the five parts of the estimand it could be mistaken for, and if the answer is any of them it is a WHAT and must be filed. The five are population, outcome, window, unit and comparison, and the comparison includes both whose rates and which pool. This is what spent architecture 2.

Look a strategy label's ban window up before spending design time on a direction, in the same breath as guard.py mechanisms and coverage. The ban is deliberately not escapable by argument, so a direction's availability is a fact to look up, not a judgement to argue.
Forecasting is not a legal objective for provider-quality-risk-adjustment: guard.py blocks it on the task type, because under forecasting the domain would be a backdrop.
Never relabel a mechanism to pass a ban. The card guards every other build and the clone screen reads it, so a false label is worse than a blocked draw.

A reflex that reaches the golden is closed at the root, not argued. Both survivors of the first cut of the documentation-path driver were properties of the golden's own size and peer group, not of the driver, and both closed with one generator constant each.

A fine internal standardisation is a peer comparison. Leave one unit out of the internal rates and recompute: if the gap widens, the unit is not deflating its own cells and the fix is to crowd its peer group rather than to shrink the unit.

A property that must be discoverable but not markable goes on an invisible ward attribute with the visible date spread across it, not on the visible date itself. Depth tied to the date made the register's year column isolate the affected rows exactly; depth tied to ward adoption left the best grouping at F1 0.67.

measured.golden: 41210 General Medicine, developed avoidable 31.92 on 4,258 planned separations

architecture_3_bound.why_tuning_cannot_fix_it: the two separations trade off directly: pushing the golden further below the leader on the record means a smaller recorded ratio, which cuts the developed excess the margin is measured on, and both are measured in the same Poisson error of the same counts
architecture_3_bound.why_scale_cannot_fix_it_at_unit_scale: the budget grows with the count and the error with its square root, so it closes at about twice the top units' volume for a bare two-and-two and four times for room, which is 30,000 to 60,000 separations a year in one cost centre, a whole hospital rather than a unit
architecture_3_bound.which_floor_fails: not the relative-distance floor: the flip clears a nearest-wrong-cell test at 1.50x and fails the sampling-noise test at 0.32 standard errors
architecture_3_bound.decision_for_the_author: retire the number, or sanction a scale beyond unit scale for the top two candidates. Not taken here.

architecture_3_reflex_test.cause: a real confound, not a tuning failure. The lag's depth follows the complication groups a unit's patients produce, and pressure injuries and delirium come from old, comorbid, long-staying patients, who are exactly the patients the published table under-adjusts for because it standardises on a risk band and an age band and nothing else. The attribute that makes a unit's record late is the attribute that makes its excess rise under finer standardisation.
architecture_3_reflex_test.why_nothing_rescues_it: within this mechanism every deep-lag unit is medical or aged and every shallow-lag one surgical, so no other golden escapes it; more volume and a deeper lag both strengthen the confounded reflex rather than weakening it

proposed_next_mechanism: Approved and built. See architecture_3_mechanism below and the design note's `## Architecture 3 mechanism, built and measured`.

architecture_3_mechanism.driver: The coding lag runs on the documentation path, not the patients. CIS_MIGRATION is when each cost centre's wards were registered on the clinical information system (a rollout from July 2022 still running at the export date); CIS_ADOPTION is how much of a ward's recording actually moved once registered, a ward property and not a date property. An episode's electronic share is the unit's adoption reached over the three quarters after registration and nothing before it; the coding lag is drawn from the electronic or the paper completeness curve accordingly. The register ships the dates; adoption is not shipped and no document states it.
architecture_3_mechanism.condition_1_orthogonality: Measured on the clean truth over the 7,763 affected in-scope episodes of the twelve candidates in the four short quarters, share coded after the pull date 0.0656. Within unit-quarter the shortfall is independent of every visible attribute the pack ships: chi2/df 0.21 risk band, 0.54 age band, 0.47 length of stay, 0.69 comorbidity, 0.00 care type and site and specialty (constant within a unit), 0.42 diagnosis related group, 0.62 month; mean absolute deviation never above 1.4 points on a 6.6 per cent base. Pooled across the twelve the residue is the units' own case mixes and is not zero; condition 3 settles whether an opponent can ride it.
architecture_3_mechanism.condition_2_isolation: Best F1 of any shipped grouping against the four shortest records is 0.67 (registration year, 2 of the 4), then hospital_code 0.57, division 0.60, detail extract coverage 0.43, specialty 0.40. The four sit at three hospitals and in four specialties and their registration dates are 2022-10, 2024-01, 2027-01 and 2027-03. Depth is a continuum, 0.42 to 9.14 per cent. Readability test 1 swept every document carrying the migration fact: four hits, all flat column definitions, none saying a cost centre reports late or that anything needs developing; the explanatory clause on published_date was cut.
architecture_3_mechanism.condition_3_reflexes: 0 of 23 reach the golden. It is first on none and in the top three of four. Reflexes land on 41220 eleven times, 41410 six, 41240 twice, once each on 41320, 41230, 41330 and 41510; 41310, 41420, 41430, 41520 and the golden are named by none. Two reached it on the first cut and both were closed at the root: the fine internal standardisation on risk band, age band and length of stay band (a leave-one-out recomputation put the gap at 162 against 127, so it was a peer comparison and not self-deflation, closed by raising the already-embedded medical and aged care units from 1.00-1.04 to 1.06-1.11) and the unweighted empirical Bayes estimator (tau2 collapses, full shrinkage ranks by expected volume where the two largest units sat 1.002x apart, closed by taking 41220's plan to 4,760; dispersion is healthy at Pearson 4.55 per df and the expected-weighted estimator names 41220 at 1.46x).
architecture_3_mechanism.ladder: R0 the record over the ten closed quarters names 41220 26.17 at 1.51x, golden 5th of 12. R1 the record over the four most recent quarters names 41320 27.59 at 1.68x, golden 12th. R2 only the quarters whose coding has stopped moving names 41220 50.68 at 1.84x, golden 3rd. R3 one network factor at each lag names 41220 38.43 at 1.44x, golden 4th. R4 the short quarters filled at the unit's own finished-quarter ratio names 41220 50.66 at 1.85x, golden 3rd. R5 developed on each cost centre's own record names 41210 44.66 at 1.604x.
architecture_3_mechanism.floors: Rung 0 position 5 of 12 (floor: 4th or 5th). First on no intermediate rung and second on none. Lowest rung margin 1.44x (floor 1.15x). Final margin 1.604x (floor 1.2x, target 1.5 to 2x). Dominance 34.47 against 17.65, ratio 1.95 (floor 1.20x). C4 nearest wrong cell 60.4 per cent away. Convergence holds on all five readings of the development, 1.53x to 1.61x.
architecture_3_mechanism.bound_loosened: Yes. The patient-driven lag paid the flip and the margin out of one uplift budget and could only reach 2nd on rung 0. The documentation-driven lag pays them separately: the golden's uplift is 311.5 complications because its wards are the ones still on paper, while the shape of its record inside the window is carried by RATIO_PATH, a level for the first six closed quarters and another for the last four. Its rate rose through 2026, which is the part of its record the pull date cuts short, so the record shows it improving while it was deteriorating.
architecture_3_mechanism.open: The graded figure 44.6597 sits 0.0097 from a bin edge at one decimal and 0.1597 at whole complications against a bar of 0.3 of the rounding unit, so centre_plans has to re-centre it once the asking sentence fixes the unit. That is the one arithmetic item left before precut.py.

architecture_5.candidate_A: the unit that held the patient at onset. Driver 0.06, distinct from task48, task103 and task184. Name robust across all four boundary conventions; figure prints 10.1, 10.2, 10.5. Discharging and admitting routes land wrong, but longest-stay and pro-rata reach the golden, because a high-propensity unit makes the spells it touches eventful and so publishes its signal at spell level.
architecture_5.diagnosis: killed by the sixth screen, not by 1.6a. The figure fork is on a boundary convention, which is closure axis 9 and must be filed anyway, unlike architecture 3 chain-ladder method family.
architecture_5.refinement: run the uniqueness test on variants that are METHODS, not on conventions the closure table already requires closed, or it rejects every construction involving an interval. Test: if pinning the varying choice is something the closure table demands anyway it is a convention; if pinning it would make the decisive step executable it is a method and the fork is fatal.
architecture_5.untested: candidate C, a construction over orderings, driver 0.05, the cleanest of the three
architecture_5.candidate_C: the count of complications whose onset precedes arrival at the charged unit, built with equal propensities so the signal lives only in the ordering. Killed by the sixth screen under both hazard shapes: four routes reach the golden without building the ordering (pre-arrival patient-days from the movement file alone, spells discharged, mean segment length, and the reported charged count itself), and discharging, longest-stay and pro-rata reach it too. architecture_5.decision_type_finding: none of the coarse ships on this objective answers a per-unit league table: task48 designation_set/set_of_items, task103 go_hold_or_stop/currency, task184 ranked_slate_under_cap/set_of_items, task192 quantity_figure/count. task188 is the one pick_one_of_n and escapes the other way, through a pooling the group sizes fix. pick_one_of_n is 13 of 32 on this objective, which is why it keeps meeting the wall: a pick over units of different size forces a per-unit quantity, which is either a count that volume publishes or a rate whose denominator is a weighting choice. Architecture 6 should change the DECISION TYPE, not the quantity.

architecture_6.shape: a designation set against the charter filed tolerance of avoidable complications per 1,000 separations, with the exposure the complications scale with (care handovers, not separations or bed-days) not filed, following task181 escape; references task180, task181, task193
